acceptance: JSX comment syntax ({/* ... */}) in .mdx files is detected and flagged by the comment policy checker.
Unit test added to tests/unit/scripts/test_comment_policy.py verifying MDX JSX comment detection.
context: Follow-up item 8 from comment-checker-review-followups. Currently listed as a known gap in docs/development/comment-policy.md.
description: .mdx pages map directly to the Markdown scanner in scripts/comment_syntax.py, meaning that top-level MDX import statements and JSX comments ({/* comment */}) outside fenced Markdown code blocks bypass the checker. Parse top-level MDX constructs with a JavaScript/TypeScript scanner or AST parser to inspect comments outside code fences.
